learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the massive scale of nutritional problems like hidden hunger across populations, and learn how governments use public health strategies to fight malnutrition!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Unlike clinical nutrition which focuses on individuals, public nutrition looks at health and nutritional issues affecting large populations, aiming to prevent disease and promote health in communities.
The main issues are Protein-Energy Malnutrition (PEM), Iron Deficiency Anemia (IDA), Vitamin A Deficiency (VAD), and Iodine Deficiency Disorders (IDD).

People might eat enough calories to feel full, but their diet lacks crucial vitamins and minerals (like Iron, Vitamin A, and Iodine). This is called 'hidden hunger' because the person doesn't look starving, but their body is.

Governments use three main strategies to fight malnutrition: Diet Diversification (eating varied foods), Nutrient Supplementation (giving vitamin pills/syrups), and Food Fortification (adding nutrients to staples like salt or milk).
Programs like ICDS (Integrated Child Development Services) and Mid-Day Meal schemes are implemented nationwide to improve the nutritional status of vulnerable groups like children and pregnant women.

fun_activity.title: 🧂 The Kitchen Safari
fun_activity.instructions: Go to your kitchen and look closely at a packet of Salt and a packet of Milk or Cooking Oil. Can you find the '+F' logo or the words 'Fortified with...'? Write down exactly which vitamins or minerals have been added to them!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize the full forms: PEM, IDA, VAD, IDD, and ICDS. They are frequently asked in 1-mark questions.
📌 Food Fortification is the most cost-effective long-term strategy for hidden hunger. Give the classic example of adding Iodine to Salt.
📌 Understand the difference between Morbidity (rate of illness) and Mortality (rate of death).
quick_recap: ⭐ Public nutrition aims to prevent diseases in the community rather than just treating individuals in hospitals.
⭐ Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness, while Iodine deficiency causes Goitre and mental retardation.
⭐ The Mid-Day meal program increases school attendance while simultaneously fighting childhood malnutrition.
